facts.fact: Bhaskaran leads the eight-man ridge party. Vasu, Sankaran and Kuttan ride in it. The men camp three hundred paces back at a cairn on the wood road with shuttered lanterns, under orders that nobody climbs above the stones, so none can witness a turning.
facts.why: needed because the ridge party must not see Neela turn, and the beat has Devan staying back with the lamp men.

facts.fact: Agreed raid signal: Neela gives two sawing calls a count apart once the drain is open and the well-house bar is up. Devan moves on the second call and goes over the wall only for the shaft, wrapping his palms against rope burn.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires him to stay back and come in only for the shaft, and ch 14 opens with her sawing call.

facts.fact: Neela told Devan on their second night together that the worst part of the shape is that nobody speaks to you. In ch 13 he talks to her while she circles the camp.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him talking quietly while she circles.

facts.fact: In shape Neela smells old bear musk, about two days old, on the wind off the Resin House.
facts.why: needed as an ominous note leading into ch 14, where Vellan appears as a bear.
